{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''Sith amulet''' had been created in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="TFotSE3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref> at some point by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="5000 BBY">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]'' mini-series, which include the appearance of [[Gav Daragon]]'s [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]], to 5,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before those of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> It had a connection to another, similar [[Jori Daragon's amulet|amulet]].<ref name="TFotSE3" />
